v15F_partial_screen.encoding: signed unary 5-unit quanta; +10 = two + dots, each driven from 5-V branch
v15F_partial_screen.note: 5 V is the per-dot branch supply. A value of 10 is represented by two 5-unit lit dots rather than forcing 10 V across one emitter.

v15G_same_model_dialogue.boundary: Same-model self-dialogue only creates perspective if inference states/sampling are not perfectly correlated. This is a protocol/error-correlation model, not measured GPT quality.

v15F_partial_result_power_relay.safety_note: 10 is represented by two 5-unit optical quanta. 10 V is not applied across the specialist chip core.

v15G_direct_affect_goal_reasoning.direct_affect_definition: caution/urgency/curiosity are direct signed modulatory states in the reasoning fabric. They change thresholds and search depth; they do not hard-code a particular action and are not claimed to be conscious feelings.
v15G_direct_affect_goal_reasoning.example_interpretation: In the locked/interior-start style ambiguity, the selected response is usually verify/challenge rather than automatically allow or block, because both threat and legitimate-occupant evidence are considered.

screen_vs_wire.conclusion: At the deliberately long 1us hold, the optical screen is not an energy win over short electrical links. Its value is reduced cross-chip wiring/visible shared state. Use only if package wiring/concurrency benefits justify the optical hold energy.

retain: hardware-revision request only for persistent physical faults
replace: v15E destination-address optical screen -> v15F partial-result working screen
architecture_decisions.optional_software_feature: same-model self-dialogue is an application option, not a new chip block
architecture_decisions.affect: direct affect may be represented as modulatory signed state; do not equate it with consciousness or subjective emotion.
